name: Chicken Croquettes
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: little mace, nutmeg, pepper, and salt

instructions.text: Mix the butter and flour together
When the milk and stock have come to a boil add them to the butter and flour
Add the meat, and let all simmer together ten minutes
Leave on the back of stove for a few minutes, but do not allow it to simmer
Pour in a dish to cool
When quite cool form into small rolls and roll in bread-crumbs, then in egg, and again in bread-crumbs

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix the butter and flour together
2. When the milk and stock have come to a boil add them to the butter and flour
3. Add the meat, and let all simmer together ten minutes
4. Add eggs pretty well beaten
5. Leave on the back of stove for a few minutes, but do not allow it to simmer
6. Pour in a dish to cool
7. When quite cool form into small rolls and roll in bread-crumbs, then in egg, and again in bread-crumbs
8. Cook in boiling lard
